issuer: Massachusetts Division of Administrative Law Appeals
title: MA DALA CR-24-0616: Macneil v. MTRS
text:
COMMONWEALTH OF MASSACHUSETTS
Middlesex, ss. Division of Administrative Law Appeals
Patricia MacNeil, No. CR-24-0616
Petitioner,
Dated: January 3, 2025
v.
Massachusetts Teachers' Retirement
System,
Respondent.
ORDER OF DISMISSAL
Petitioner Patricia MacNeil's last day of work was June .30, 2024. She completed her
portion of a retirement application on July 15. Despite Ms. MacNeil's requests for speedy
action, her employer did not complete its portion of the application until September 17.
A member is entitled to retire as of her last day of work only if the retirement application
was "filed with the [pertinent retirement board] not more than sixty days after such date." G.L.
c. 32, § 10(3). That requirement was not satisfied in the unfortunate circumstances presented
here. See Moynahan v. Essex Cty. Ret. Bd., 9 Mass. L. Rptr. 232, 234 (Essex Super. 1998).
A prior order outlined the foregoing analysis and directed Ms. MacNeil to file an
affidavit and any exhibits in support of her appeal. The order advised Ms. MacNeil that her
failure to make that submission would result in dismissal.
Ms. MacNeil has filed nothing further. It is therefore ORDERED that this appeal is
DISMISSED.
Division of Administrative Law Appeals
Isl Yakov Malkiel
Y akov Malkiel
Administrative Magistrate
